in_marathi.name: Omansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bow to the Lord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Omansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘om’ meaning ‘bow’ and ‘nasa’ meaning ‘lord’. Omansh is a name that signifies reverence towards the divine.

in_bengali.name: Omansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bow to the Lord
in_bengali.long_meaning: Omansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘om’ meaning ‘bow’ and ‘nasa’ meaning ‘lord’. Omansh is a name that signifies reverence towards the divine.
